description: A server entry point for Remix framework handling HTTP requests, differentiating between bot and browser requests, and managing server-side rendering streams.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function handling incoming HTTP requests, setting CORS headers, and delegating to bot or browser handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests, streaming HTML content via React's renderToPipeableStream.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, similarly streaming the HTML content.
